pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with rounded vertices and soft-edge pixel gradients. Spatial area increases from the dorsal ridge toward the mid-flank, where patches are larger and more elongated.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with frequent tri-point junction nodes. Pathways exhibit narrower pixel thickness in the upper regions, broadening into wider gaps between larger mid-flank patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the neck and shoulder ridge, presenting a continuous sawtooth-like profile against the background.
